class.name: GamepadMap
class.brief_description: A set of gamepad bindings loaded into [InputRouter] together.
class.description: A list of [RouteBindingResource]s with a default [GamepadContext]. [method InputRouter.load_map] attaches every binding under one handle, and [method InputRouter.unload_map] detaches them all. Each binding goes into its own [member RouteBindingResource.context] if set, otherwise into [member context]. In the editor, the inspector lists the map's bindings with the findings of [method InputRouter.check_maps] for this map alone. On export, every map in the project is baked into [member ProjectSettings.input_devices/router/baked_map].

members.member: The bindings this map attaches. Null entries are skipped.
The context for bindings that name none. Registered with [method InputRouter.register_gamepad_context] when the map loads.
